activities.title: Distributed Microservices Hands-on Lab
activities.description: Build an event-driven pub/sub architecture using Redis and Node.js. Students will deploy their worker nodes locally and verify message throughput.
activities.deliverable_spec: GitHub repository URL with Dockerfile and a 30s demonstration video link.

activities.title: Graph Algorithms: Shortest Paths Deep Dive
activities.description: Solve 5 contest problems on Codeforces with live editorial and complexity breakdowns.
activities.deliverable_spec: Codeforces handle and submission ID links.

activities.title: Fine-Tuning Small Language Models with LoRA
activities.description: Fine-tuning Qwen 2.5 on specialized campus FAQ data using PyTorch and HuggingFace.
activities.deliverable_spec: Colab notebook link and evaluation loss chart.

activities.title: Venture Pitch Simulation: Seed Stage
activities.topic: Unit Economics, Market Sizing & Pitch Decks
activities.description: Teams pitch a real SaaS or hardware business idea to guest angel mentors.
activities.deliverable_spec: PDF Pitch deck (max 10 slides) and financial model sheet.

activities.title: Autumn Acoustic Jam & Stage Lighting Workshop
activities.description: Live acoustic jam session followed by hands-on lighting console training.
activities.deliverable_spec: High-resolution recording snippet and cue sheet.

events.name: Gambade 2026 - Annual Inter-Campus Sports Olympiad
events.description: The premier inter-campus sporting championship uniting MSOT campuses. Features track & field, football leagues, basketball, and table tennis.
events.venue: MSOT Central Sports Complex & Athletics Arena
events.rules: Teams must adhere to official collegiate guidelines. Mandatory sports kit required. Fair play rules strictly enforced by referee council.
events.schedule_details: Day 1: Track & Field preliminaries; Day 2: Football and Basketball Knockouts; Day 3: Finals & Closing Ceremonies.

events.name: Mirai HackTech 2026 - 24hr AI & Systems Hackathon
events.description: Build cutting-edge distributed microservices, agentic AI pipelines, or edge hardware within 24 hours. Evaluated by venture founders and tech directors.
events.rules: Teams of 2-4 members. No pre-written code; boilerplates allowed. Git commits timestamped. Live deployment required at evaluation.
events.schedule_details: Saturday 10:00 AM: Problem statement reveal; Saturday 11:00 AM: Sprint starts; Sunday 11:00 AM: Code freeze & pitches.

events.name: International Conference on Next-Gen Computing (ICNGC 2026)
events.description: Collegiate research symposium presenting novel student research papers, system designs, and algorithmic breakthroughs to global academia.
events.venue: Main Convocation Hall & Hybrid Global Stream
events.rules: Individual registrations. Submissions peer-reviewed by IEEE student chapter committee. Oral presentation length: 15 minutes.
events.schedule_details: Day 1: Keynote on Distributed AI; Day 2: Parallel research paper tracks and poster displays.

events.name: Cross Road 2026 - Annual Cultural & Performing Arts Fest
events.description: Battle of the bands, street theatre, classical dance showcases, debate showdowns, and acoustic night hosted by Malhar Cultural Society.
events.rules: Solo performances: 4-6 minutes. Group acts: up to 12 members. Professional acoustics provided.
events.schedule_details: Friday Eve: Inauguration; Saturday: Competitive events; Sunday: Grand Pro-Night.
